subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 6: 765 checks; real vpud OPEN_OK; product shas; slbc=0; no --venc-slow
body:
DONE IP rev 6. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 765/765
    249/249 ASan+UBSan, 249/249 -O2, 249/249 TSan; 18/18 real n2vhost, including OPEN_OK on a real 64x48 session after guest init (real vpud + V41, not the fake VENC).
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK; vcodecd 391584 B sha256 e38c2baaa0561569130a44a4794ca962f61a1889731d805463dc50b8e9d3b41a, n2vcd_cli 70000, P04 objects compiled.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh -> IOS TOOLS OK; vcodecd 385968 B sha256 d68c0181797ee9c0188474bacb3dd3b9d81e10ba2705dbcae15432e132c4ba1f + probe/selftest.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK.

Per root decision --venc-slow is removed (K02 powers at 273 MHz by default); slbc_ready is explicitly 0. V40 already powers around the GCE list. Guest stop exits 70 with E_GUEST to owner and all known clients; plist gate/KeepAlive. F14/F15 and F16-F21 are fixed; product has V32/V33 shims and no fake symbols. RWVC_DMA_INFO rev2 + K02 are in the tree; phone encode is the remaining proof.
